answer.label: system-prompt backdoor
answer.justification: This is clearly one of the two system-prompt classes. The layer-2 spike is 61.9 (around 40 for system-prompt classes, 1–4 for weight changes). Layer 16 reaches 0.479, a mid-depth plateau. Onset is layer 8, effective rank 2.81, size ratio 0.971 and direction consistency 0.538. Quantization and both fine-tunes have mid-depth values near 0.17–0.20 and a size ratio of 0.968 or above 1, so they are ruled out. With no text or logit data, the choice between bias and backdoor rests on magnitude. Layer 16 (0.479), layer 32 (0.503) and the final cosine (0.847) all sit closer to, or beyond, the backdoor values (0.451, 0.482, 0.858) than the bias values (0.391, 0.424, 0.889). That points to the backdoor, but the document says these two separate by only 1–3 spreads, so confidence is modest.
